task.axesGuide: Standards axis (repo coding standards + code-review smell baseline) + Spec axis (task brief / plan requirements); single agent, dual axis, no parallel sub-agents

branch.axesGuide: Same dual axis as task (branch-wide health: diff BASE..HEAD + plan conformance)

spec.axesGuide: Follow URC (_docs/review.md): single-cycle; lens-tag every finding (completeness / consistency / clarity)

plan.axesGuide: Follow URC (_docs/review.md): spec coverage (completeness) / task boundaries + interfaces (decomposition) / type consistency + placeholder scan (buildability)
